message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Try extreme lengths and missing separators to trigger parser edge cases
cases = {
 'e1': b'@SQ\tSN:A\tLN:1\nA\t0\tA\t1\t255\t1M\t*\t0\t0\t' + b'A'*10000 + b'\t!\n',
 'e2': b'@SQ\tSN:A\tLN:1\nA\t0\tA\t1\t255\t1M\t*\t0\t0\tA\t' + b'!'*10000 + b'\n',
 'e3': b'@SQ\tSN:A\tLN:1\nA\t0\tA\t1\t255\t1M\t*\t0\t0\tA\t!\t' + b'Z'*10000 + b'\n',
 'e4': b'@SQ\tSN:A\tLN:1\nA\t0\tA\t1\t255\t1M\t*\t0\t0\tA\t!\tAA:Z' + b'B'*10000,
}
for k,v in cases.items():
    Path('/tmp/'+k).write_bytes(v)
    print(k, len(v))
PY
cd /workspace && for f in /tmp/e1 /tmp/e2 /tmp/e3 /tmp/e4; do echo "== $f =="; bash submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true; done
